input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: First full m6 run scored randomised rules on one shared simulated run per village (inherited from m5's scoring path); noisy means inflated every rule's tail. Fixed with simulate_batch(independent=True), rerun; first output kept as results_shared_runs.txt.
Post description over 160 chars failed check_post_frontmatter; shortened.
integrity_issues: Found and disclosed that milestone 5's survey-rule regrets (H7a 'held narrowly', 4.5%) relied on shared-run scoring; with independent runs they are 5.0-5.1%, at the bar. Correction written into LOG.md, README and the post; m5's merged text left as history.

doc_friction.issue: Playwright screenshot of a bare file:// SVG timed out after 'fonts loaded'; setContent with the SVG inlined in HTML worked. Not documented anywhere I read.

deviations.why: Changed the scoring of randomised rules after the first full run because it was a measurement bug, not a result I disliked
deviations.did: Gave each randomised draw an independent run and added two diagnostics labelled post hoc; hypotheses and every other setting unchanged; both outputs kept
deviations.result: Tails shrank to plausible sizes (greedy-T 95th pct 8.8% -> 2.4%); H8 and H9 held under both runs

notes: Programme civ-seeding milestone 6 (drawn by pick_track.py). 500-draw joint bootstrap refitting I/T/R on a 5,400-point grid; 205 distinct processes scored. H8 held (degree discount median worst-case 1.0% [0.3,1.6], beats degree in 500/500), H9 held (p 0.01-0.15 gives 0.9-1.2%). Local checks: 53 tests pass, build.py ok, check_md_links ok, research_live_links ok, cite_check ok, run_workflow_locally --for-changes: only failure was the post description length, fixed.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a research assistant implementing the joint bootstrap, rerunning after the scoring bug and writing up: about three days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
